title: Stop Crossing Your Arms When Turning (Part 2)
hook: Never twist your hands turning corners.

script.narration: Never twist your hands turning corners.
script.visual_search: driver hands twisting steering wheel awkwardly close up

script.narration: Part 2! For high speed turns, use the push and pull method. Slide your hands up and down the wheel without crossing your arms to keep total vehicle stability.
script.visual_search: driver hands using push and pull steering technique

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this method? Comment yes or no. So remember...
script.visual_search: hands steering wheel smooth highway driving

description:
Part 2 of our Steering Control series! Learn the exact hand placement and speed control for high speed turns without crossing your arms.

Quick driving lessons every day with Learn in 60 Seconds.
why_it_will_work: Direct continuation of a proven top-performing series on the channel, fulfilling the promise made in Part 1 about high-speed turns.
